zh.title: 法國航空A350-900據報偏離離場程序 與美國航空A321-200近乎空中相撞
zh.summary: 法國航空A350據報偏離離場程序；管制員立即向兩機組下達指示
body: 法國航空一架空中巴士A350-900與美國航空一架空中巴士A321-200，於2026年11月7日自洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）起飛後不久，發生近乎空中相撞事件。AeroTime報導，法國航空航機據報偏離指定離場程序，空中交通管制隨即向兩架飛機的機組下達指示。
法國航空AF28自24L跑道起飛，美國航空AA1660則自25R跑道起飛。美國航空機組回報當時高度為2,000英尺，正爬升至5,000英尺；管制員要求其維持2,000英尺。法國航空機組也獲指示立即轉向270度。
AeroTime表示，截至2026年11月8日，尚未公開官方調查結果，也沒有法國航空航機非預期轉向的確認解釋。

en.title: Air France Airbus A350-900 reportedly deviates; near miss with American Airlines Airbus A321-200
en.summary: Air France A350 reportedly deviated from its departure procedure; ATC immediately instructed both crews.
body: An Air France Airbus A350-900 and an American Airlines Airbus A321-200 were involved in a near-mid-air collision shortly after departing Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on November 7, 2026. AeroTime reported that the Air France aircraft reportedly deviated from its assigned departure procedure; air traffic control then issued immediate instructions to both flight crews.

Air France Flight AF28 departed Runway 24L, while American Airlines AA1660 took off from Runway 25R. The American Airlines crew reported being at 2,000 feet and climbing toward 5,000 feet; controllers instructed it to maintain 2,000 feet. The Air France crew was also instructed to turn immediately to heading 270 degrees.
AeroTime said that, as of November 8, 2026, no official investigation findings or confirmed explanation for the Air France aircraft’s unexpected turn had been made public.
